mapper.select: SELECT MAX_MEMBER_COUNT FROM ( SELECT P.MAX_MEMBER_COUNT FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID WHERE S.UNIV_ID = #{univId} AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND S.ENDED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE UNIV_ID = #{univId} AND STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')
